name: proofread
description: Transcribe a video with Sonilo and translate the transcript into editable .srt files — one per target language, plus the detected source language — so the wording can be read and corrected before anything is dubbed. Nothing is spoken and no video is produced; this is the step before dubbing, and the corrected files go back to the dubbing tool as subtitles so the dub speaks exactly the approved lines. Use when the user wants to review, approve or fix the translation before dubbing, wants editable
author: sonilo-ai
